domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record located. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not retrievable: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned 404 for the guessed slug, and Google search returned HTTP 429. No GSTIN, turnover figure or contract is asserted here — all null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: 4 dated customs export records (14.08.2025–27.09.2025) with destination, HS code and B/L number, all air cargo from Bombay, destinations USA, Germany (x2) and Kenya. Note the declared HS set (291632;291719;291816;294000) does not match the HS codes actually shipped (28332910, 29061390, 28259040, 29155000) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual codes should be recorded. The second slug variant (anmol-chemicals-pharmaceuticals-private-limited) returned an empty record table, so only the first slug is evidenced. Domestic supply: no traces of supply found in accessible public sources — status unknown, not 'conditionally accepted'. Registered address per ImportKey: Plot No. J-29, MIDC Taloja Industrial Area, Taluka Panvel (Maharashtra). Revenue and export volume figures are null: not public in the sources read.
